extraction.notes: 2027 offerings supersede the 2026 brochure, including changed grade bands and program names. Program descriptions, eligibility and schedules below use the supplied official 2027 pages unless otherwise noted. Individual program pages opened with empty text in this browser; official search results supplemented them. Prices shown as 'From' on the overview were not treated as complete tuition tiers. No dated registration opening was found. The official registration page directs summer 2027 registration to CampWise. Appalachian Impact also mentions Lutherock; this extraction covers the Lutheridge offering, and its individual session details need review.

excluded.name: bRIDGE
excluded.reason: Family-only program in September, outside summer.

excluded.name: Faith Ablaze
excluded.reason: Youth weekend in January, outside summer.

cards.name: PreKamp
cards.description: Children participate in songs, crafts, games, a water day and a Bible story each morning.

hours.quote: PreKamp runs 9:00am to 1:00pm, Monday through Friday

lunch.details: Campers bring lunch; a snack is provided.
lunch.quote: Campers bring their own lunch. A snack is provided.

cards.name: Day Camp
cards.description: Campers swim, practice archery and canoeing, climb, hike and make crafts. Each week has a different theme.

grades.quote: Day Camp at Lutheridge gives kids who’ve completed kindergarten through 4th grade a full summer camp experience — no packing required.

hours.quote: Drop them off at 8:00 am, and pick up a tired, happy, mud-splattered kid at 4:30 pm.

lunch.quote: Breakfast and lunch are both included.

cards.name: Pioneers
cards.description: Campers canoe, swim, join campfires, make crafts and participate in team challenges with cabin counselors.

cards.name: Pioneer Sampler
cards.description: A two-night introduction to overnight camp for children not ready for a full week.

cards.name: Climb High
cards.description: Campers use the indoor climbing wall and challenge tower, then visit a nearby high ropes course.

cards.name: Crazy Cool Campout
cards.description: Campers spend a night in tents, hike to waterfalls and cook dinner over a fire.

cards.name: Cave & Wave Explorers
cards.description: Campers visit Worley's Cave, spend a day whitewater rafting and camp out overnight.

cards.name: Night Owl Explorers
cards.description: Campers follow a later schedule with glow games, late swims and a sunset hike on Bearwallow Mountain.

cards.name: Bike & Hike Explorers
cards.description: Campers take mountain biking lessons, ride a trail in Dupont State Forest and hike in Pisgah.

cards.name: River Explorers
cards.description: Campers tube the French Broad River and choose camp activities throughout the week.

cards.name: Wild Waters Explorers
cards.description: Campers take a canoe trip, spend a night beside the water and go whitewater rafting.

cards.name: Parkway Peak Explorers
cards.description: Campers hike two summits near the Blue Ridge Parkway and camp overnight above 5,000 feet.

cards.name: Sky Explorers
cards.description: Campers spend a day on a high ropes course with bridges, cable walks and climbs up to 25 feet.

cards.name: Kairos Confirmation Camp
cards.description: A confirmation week combines keynote sessions, worship led by Kairos musicians and small-group conversations.

cards.name: Campfirmation
cards.description: Pastors teach confirmation through the seasons of the church year.

cards.name: Parkway Peak Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers camp below Mount Mitchell and hike to its summit.

cards.name: Rock & Raft Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers climb and hike at Lutherock, spend a night camping out and go whitewater rafting.

cards.name: Cave & Wave Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers visit Worley's Cave, go whitewater rafting and spend a night camping out, with a focus on leadership.

cards.name: Night Owl Mountaineers
cards.description: A late-night camp week runs during the Fourth of July and Christmas in July themes and introduces what being a counselor involves.

cards.name: Wild Waters Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers take a canoe expedition with an overnight beside the water and spend a day whitewater rafting.

cards.name: Road Trip: Charleston
cards.description: A small group travels to Charleston, stays on the Isle of Palms, participates in a service project and visits the beach.

cards.name: Summershine
cards.description: Teens and adults with developmental disabilities participate in crafts, swimming, music and faith activities, with counselors at a 1-to-4 ratio.

special_needs.details: Program for teens and adults with developmental disabilities; counselor ratio 1 to 4.
special_needs.quote: A full week of camp for teens and adults with developmental disabilities. Crafts, swimming, music, faith and community, with counselors at a 1 to 4 ratio.

cards.name: Appalachian Impact
cards.description: Youth groups spend a summer service week helping neighbors rebuild after Hurricane Helene, followed by an adventure day.
